issue.title: [module-contract 01/12] Implement manifest loading and typed projections (#108)

body:
Relay BB run pushed an update.

Pull request: #293

Tokens: 0 · Cost: $0.0000

Pushed successfully to branch `bb/relay-108-module-contract-01-12-implement-manife-thr_x2584gcrs8`.

## Summary

Implements issue #108: `ModuleManifest` type and `ModuleRegistry` in `backend/packages/module-registry`.

- **`manifest.ts`** — `ModuleManifest` interface and a zod schema covering `id`, `version`, `name`, `removable`, `systemProject`, `databases`, `capabilities`, `agentTools`, plus optional `viewTypes`, `heartbeatActions`, `heartbeatRuleKinds`, `taskNames`, `workers`, `migrations`. Task descriptors are exactly `{ name, payloadSchemaExport, handlerExport }`.
- **`registry.ts`** — `ModuleRegistry.loadModule(path)` uses an explicit known-path dynamic `import`, validates the manifest's structural shape, verifies every named `handlerExport`/`payloadSchemaExport` actually exists on the imported module, and rejects duplicate module ids/names or duplicate database keys/agent-tool/task/worker names across modules — all failing synchronously so a bad module blocks startup loudly. Activation is resolved fresh on every call via an injected `ActiveModuleIdsSource` (not cached at load time), so deactivating a module drops it from every projection immediately. Only narrow, per-aspect projection methods are exposed (databases, capabilities, agent tools, view types, heartbeat actions/rule kinds, tasks, workers, migrations, system-project ids) — no method returns the raw manifest, and an agent tool whose capability isn't granted is omitted entirely rather than returned as denied.
- Added fixtures and a 9-test suite covering valid loads, invalid shape, missing exports, duplicate ids/keys, activation filtering, capability filtering, and dynamic re-evaluation.

Verified in this run: `tsc --noEmit` clean, `pnpm -r run build` clean across all 7 backend packages, and the full `vitest run` suite passing (25 test files, 322 tests).

Pushed successfully to branch `bb/relay-108-module-contract-01-12-implement-manife-thr_x2584gcrs8` (existing PR #293).

## Summary

Addressed the code-review findings from PR #293:

- **Unmet acceptance criterion**: `ModuleRegistry.loadModule` no longer returns the raw `ModuleManifest`; it now returns only the loaded module's id, so every consumer must go through the narrow, activation-filtered projection getters (`getDatabases`, `getAgentTools`, `getTasks`, etc.).
- **Medium correctness finding**: `claimCrossModuleIdentifiers` was non-atomic — a module colliding partway through its own claims (e.g. its second database key) left its earlier keys registered to a module that was never actually added to the registry, corrupting future loads. It's now check-then-commit: every candidate identifier is validated against existing owners and against duplicates within the same manifest before anything is claimed.
- **Low-priority coverage gaps**: added tests for `getCapabilities()`'s cross-module dedup/activation filtering, and duplicate-name rejection for agent tool, task, and worker names, plus a regression test proving the atomic-claim fix.

The local branch had also fallen behind the remote (which had picked up automatic `develop` merges via PR #292/#293's branch-update commits), so I rebased my fix commit onto the current remote tip before pushing — no conflicts.

Verified on the final state: `tsc --noEmit` clean, `pnpm -r run build` clean across all packages, and the full `vitest run` suite passes (27 test files, 341 tests).
